newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorca Resources proposes warrant changes.
newsitem.headline: Minorca Resources proposes warrant changes.

text.p: Minorca Resources Inc said on Friday that lead underwriter ScotiaMcLeod Inc is proposing a restructuring of Minorca's recent special warrant financing.
Under the terms of the proposal, each special warrant would become entitled to two common shares, one half of a common share purchase warrant and C$1 cash.
The common share purchase warrant would have an exercise price of C$1.50 and expire on March 13, 1999.
If the proposal is accepted by special warrant holders, the cash payment to holders would be C$11 million. About C$69 million cash would remain on Minorca's balance sheet.
The proposal is also subject to approval from the board of directors, common shareholders and regulators.
